messages:
Incident Bot: INCIDENT ALERT for tenant=harborbank · Dedicated GPU pool us-west-2a · model=redwood-13b-v2 · elevated 5xx + increased queue latency. Pager fired. Impact: customer requests hitting timeouts (~10% error rate). Please acknowledge in thread.

Sanjay (oncall): acknowledged. seeing memory-pressure spikes and OOM kills on nodes in harborbank-dedicated-pool-*-usw2a. kube events show accelerated pod restarts.

Maya (eng-sre): what’s the immediate customer impact? Is it all models or just 13b-v2?

Sanjay (oncall): logs show 13b-v2 decode failing when seq_len > 1024. 7b and embeddings unaffected. Traffic mix: ~70% 13b-v2. Error snippet: ```rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted desc = failed to allocate 6.8G for attention_kv```

Oliver (customer-ops): HarborBank on Dedicated w/ high SLA. They’re seeing app timeouts and have started failover to backup UI, but merchant flows are impacted. They want a mitigation that avoids model regression.

Maya (eng-sre): recommend immediate model override for this tenant to a safe variant while we stabilize nodes. Options: pin to redwood-13b-v1-safe (same family) or fallback to redwood-7b-quant (smaller). For minimal regression, pin to 13b-v1-safe.

Sanjay (oncall): agree. Planning steps: 1) apply tenant override (control-plane) to pin to redwood-13b-v1-safe until 2026-03-16T02:00:00Z 2) scale down concurrency target for harb-pool to avoid new placements 3) drain affected nodes for maintenance 4) notify customer.

Zuri (solutions): I’ll draft the customer message. hold for confirmation on model variant. keep it non-technical.

Maya (eng-sre): executing override now. Command: ```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/tenants/harborbank/overrides" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"override_type":"model_pin","model":"redwood-13b-v1-safe","pin_until":"2026-03-16T02:00:00Z","reason":"runtime OOM on 13b-v2; safe fallback to maintain SLA"}'
```

Maya (eng-sre): API returned 200. override_id=ovr_8f3b2. Routing now should pick the pinned variant for all new requests from harborbank.

Sanjay (oncall): throttling concurrency and autoscaler for harborbank pool to prevent churn: ```
kubectl patch hpa harborbank-dedicated --patch '{"spec": {"maxReplicas": 6}}'
``` applying now.

Eran (infra): I’ll start node maintenance cycle and increase logging for KV cache to confirm root cause. ETA for drain + reboot of 3 nodes: ~25 minutes.

Oliver (customer-ops): thanks — please send me a short customer-friendly blurb. I’ll post to their escalation channel and the Jira incident.

Zuri (solutions): Suggested copy: "We’re seeing degraded model performance for one of the models used by your service. We’ve temporarily routed your requests to a stable model variant to restore service while we investigate. Expect minimal functional change; we’ll update you within 30 minutes." Want to add SLA note?

Oliver (customer-ops): fine. add: "This change is reversible and will not affect your data." send once override confirmed.

Maya (eng-sre): override is in effect and traffic test shows requests returning successfully on redwood-13b-v1-safe. 5xxs dropped to <1% and p95 latency improved.

Sanjay (oncall): rolling maintenance started on affected nodes. watch for any regression after node rejoin. If errors reappear, fallback plan B: switch harborbank to redwood-7b-quant (lower memory) + temporary rate limiting.

Eran (infra): node1 drained -> rebooted -> rejoined. node2 draining. observing KV cache warmup; no immediate OOMs.

Maya (eng-sre): quick post-action checklist: - override applied (ovr_8f3b2) - maintenance in progress - customer notified pending confirmation from Oliver - will keep override until we validate stability or do controlled rollout back to v2 with seq_len caps.

Oliver (customer-ops): message sent to HarborBank channel with Zuri’s copy and note about revert window. they replied: "App is back to normal, thanks." :thumbsup:

Sanjay (oncall): marked mitigation successful for now. leaving handoff to Eran for overnight watch. Eran — please pick up at 2026-03-15T22:00:00Z and validate that: 1) override remains active if needed 2) node health stable 3) no new regressions.

Eran (infra): taking over. I’ll spool up a health dashboard and add an alert for model-specific OOMs for harborbank pool.

Maya (eng-sre): filing a follow-up postmortem and an action item to add an automated tenant-safe-variant policy: if sustained OOMs detected, auto-apply model_pin to preapproved safe variants and notify on-call.

Sanjay (oncall): +1 — that would cut mitigation time. closing pager for now. :white_check_mark:

Incident Bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigation applied, customer impact restored). Thread closed but monitoring continued under ovw_8f3b2.
